author: goyboy97
quote: 4 hours in and I'm already bored. 13 years of waiting for a 30 FPS target that can't even consistently hold 30, excessive motion blur, sluggish gameplay and a painfully mundane opening. Half the experience feels like a relationship simulator, running errands and putting up with insufferable characters instead of enjoying the freedom GTA was built on. Rockstar seems so obsessed with cinematic realism that it's forgotten what makes a game enjoyable. Visually ambitious, technically compromised and painfully slow. The near-perfect critic scores make the disconnect with actual players even more laughable. More realistic doesn't automatically mean more fun.
